Construction Services in Cheney, KS

Cheney is a Sedgwick County community of roughly 2,200 residents in the rolling plains west of Wichita, near the Cheney Reservoir on the North Fork of the Ninnescah River. The area attracts homeowners who want a small-town environment within commuting distance of Wichita — and the housing stock reflects that: a mix of older Cheney townsite properties, farmsteads on rural routes, and some newer residential construction drawn by the reservoir and outdoor recreation access.

Wheatland Construction serves Cheney and western Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, family-owned since 2018. We permit through Sedgwick County for unincorporated Cheney-area properties and through the City of Cheney for in-town work.

What We Build in Cheney

Custom Homes

The Cheney area — particularly the reservoir corridor — has become a destination for homeowners building on recreational lots or rural acreage. We build custom homes in the Cheney area from foundation to finish, handling permits through Sedgwick County or the City of Cheney as the location requires. See Custom Home Building in Cheney →

Home Additions

Cheney's older housing stock frequently has limited square footage by modern standards. Room additions — a master bedroom, an expanded great room, a garage addition — are practical investments for homeowners who want to stay in Cheney but need more space. See Home Additions in Cheney →

Basement Finishing

Cheney's residential properties include homes with unfinished basements that represent untapped living space. The western Sedgwick County soil profile — predominantly clay and mixed loam — can create seasonal moisture pressure, so moisture assessment before framing is essential. We evaluate every Cheney basement before quoting. See Basement Finishing in Cheney →

Bathroom Remodeling

Cheney's older homes have original bathrooms from the mid-20th century that have seen decades of use. Original cast-iron drain lines, galvanized supply pipes, and dated finishes are standard. We remodel them completely — new supply and drain work where needed, new tile, new vanity and countertop, new fixtures. See Bathroom Remodeling in Cheney →

Kitchen Remodeling

Cheney kitchen remodels range from targeted refreshes in newer homes to comprehensive overhauls of original farmhouse kitchens. We work with layouts that make sense and reconfigure those that don't — always with permits, always with our own crews. See Kitchen Remodeling in Cheney →

Major Remodels

Older Cheney-area farmhouses and townsite homes often need broader renovation — structural changes, comprehensive interior updates, or full-floor renovations that go well beyond a single room. We manage major remodel scopes with coordinated trades and full permit coverage. See Major Remodels in Cheney →

Roofing

Western Sedgwick County sees strong southwest winds and spring hail exposure. Cheney-area properties — particularly those on rural routes with less windbreak — experience meaningful storm exposure. We install roofing systems appropriate for western Kansas conditions and handle insurance documentation where applicable. See Roofing in Cheney →

Cheney Permit Jurisdiction

In-town Cheney properties permit through the City of Cheney. Rural properties on county routes outside city limits permit through Sedgwick County. We determine the correct jurisdiction for your property and manage all permits and inspections.

Why Cheney Homeowners Choose Wheatland

We serve the full western Sedgwick County corridor and we understand the rural and small-town residential considerations in the Cheney area. Written estimates, own crews, no added charges after the fact.
